# MCP tools

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-api-docs.py from the node's source. Do not edit by hand. -->

The node serves 429 Model Context Protocol tools over Streamable HTTP at `/mcp`: 254 typed tools with their own input schema, and 175 mirror tools that each forward a `params` object to one JSON-RPC method. Every tool runs under the caller's own credentials: the method's gate applies exactly as on JSON-RPC (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)), and no tool signs with a user key. Who may reach `/mcp` at all is the node's access policy for the `mcp` surface (see [ACCESS.md](ACCESS.md)).

`/mcp/compact` serves the same tools behind two: `search` finds tools by words in their name, description or JSON-RPC method and returns each match with its exact input and output schema, and `call` invokes one by name, its arguments checked against that schema first. A `call` takes the same path as calling the tool on `/mcp`: the same credentials, agent terms, spend limits, receipts and audit. An unknown tool or arguments the schema refuses are invalid params, with `data.reason` `unknown_tool` or `invalid_arguments`.

Protocol revision. The node speaks MCP revision 2026-07-28 and no other, and `server/discover` lists exactly that. The revision has no `initialize` handshake and no session: a client opens with `server/discover`, or with any request, and every request carries `_meta` with `io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion` and `io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities` (`io.modelcontextprotocol/clientInfo` is optional). A request missing either key is invalid params (-32602) naming the missing keys. A request whose `_meta` names another revision, and an `initialize` request naming any revision, is refused with -32022 `Unsupported protocol version`; its `data` carries `requested`, `supported` (the revisions listed above) and, for `initialize`, `opener` (`server/discover`). Clients that only speak an earlier revision, which opens with `initialize`, are not served.

Two transports carry the same protocol. Streamable HTTP at `/mcp` is stateless with JSON replies; each POST sends `MCP-Protocol-Version` and `Mcp-Method` (and `Mcp-Name` for `tools/call`) and is gated by the node's access policy. The iroh ALPN `tenzro/mcp` runs one session per bidirectional stream as newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0; the first line may be `server/discover` or any request with the `_meta` above, and every later line carries it too. The stream has no credential and no verified caller, so over iroh only the read-only tools are listed and callable; any other tool, including one that changes state, is refused with -32600 `not authorized over the iroh MCP transport` before it runs. For gated inference use the `tenzro/infer` ALPN.

Resources are the one template `tenzro://events{?filter,from_cursor}` (`resources/templates/list`); `resources/list` is empty, `resources/read` returns the next page of chain events with proofs, and `resources/subscribe` sends `notifications/resources/updated`. The agent surface (A2A 1.0) is separate: JSON-RPC at `/a2a` over HTTPS with the `A2A-Version: 1.0` header, and over the iroh ALPN `tenzro/a2a` (unary methods only; `SendStreamingMessage` needs HTTPS). `SendMessage` and `CancelTask` need the DID envelope on both.

Errors come back as MCP tool errors carrying the JSON-RPC error of the method the tool called (code and message), or an invalid-params error when the arguments do not match the input schema.

## Typed tools

### `access_challenge`

Start signing in to this node. Returns a single-use challenge for `did`, bound to the DPoP key whose RFC 7638 thumbprint is `dpop_jkt`. Answer it with `issue_access_token`: a passkey signs `challenge` (webauthn.get), a hardware key signs `device_digest`.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `did` | `String` | yes | The DID signing in |
| `dpop_jkt` | `String` | yes | RFC 7638 SHA-256 thumbprint of the DPoP key the token will be bound to |

**Calls.** `tenzro_accessChallenge` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "access_challenge", "arguments": {"did": "did:tenzro:human:…", "dpop_jkt": "…"}}}
```

### `adaptive_burn_get_config`

Show the current adaptive burn-rate config — base and local fee burn bps with their treasury complements. The dial moves only via on-chain governance proposals (see adaptive_burn_get_recommendation).

**Input.** None.

**Calls.** `tenzro_getBurnRateConfig` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "adaptive_burn_get_config", "arguments": {}}}
```

### `adaptive_burn_get_metrics`

Show the latest supply-side metrics snapshot — block height, circulating supply, rolling-window epoch delta, burn breakdown, and supply added (always 0: TNZO supply is fixed; the emission_breakdown field name is kept). Drives the recommendation engine.

**Input.** None.

**Calls.** `tenzro_getSupplyMetrics` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "adaptive_burn_get_metrics", "arguments": {}}}
```

### `adaptive_burn_get_recommendation`

Show the current adaptive-burn recommendation — action (NoChange / IncreaseBurnPct / DecreaseBurnPct / AlarmHighInflation, a supply increase the ledger refuses, so a fault / AlarmHighDeflation), magnitude bps, and whether it's above the auto-proposal floor. Pure function of metrics + targets, no side effects.

**Input.** None.

**Calls.** `tenzro_getBurnRateRecommendation` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "adaptive_burn_get_recommendation", "arguments": {}}}
```

### `add_machine_access`

Add a machine-access grant: let the node's jobs, or one agent or tool, reach a network range, a local service or a folder on this machine. Needs the machine owner's approval of a machine_access_challenge for exactly these terms; nothing else can add a grant.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `grantee_did` | `String` | yes | The node's machine DID for any sandboxed job on it, or an agent or tool DID |
| `resources` | `Vec<MachineResourceWire>` | yes | Resources: {"kind":"network","cidr":"10.20.0.0/16","port":8080} (port optional) or {"kind":"folder","path":"/var/lib/tenzro/inbox"} |
| `operations` | `Vec<String>` | yes | connect for networks; read and/or write for folders |
| `expires_at_ms` | `i64` | yes | When the grant ends, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch |
| `max_uses_per_minute` | `Option<u32>` | no |  |
| `max_bytes` | `Option<u64>` | no | Most bytes moved through the grant |
| `authorization` | `Option<CustodyAuthorizationWire>` | no | The owner's approval of the challenge from machine_access_challenge: challenge_id, credential_id_hex, assertion over its webauthn_challenge, and ml_dsa_signature_hex when the owner has a hardware ML-DSA-65 key enrolled |

**Calls.** `tenzro_addMachineAccess` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "add_machine_access", "arguments": {"grantee_did": "did:tenzro:human:…", "resources": [], "operations": [], "expires_at_ms": 0}}}
```

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "agent_account_sync", "arguments": {"did": "did:tenzro:human:…", "chain": "…"}}}
```

### `agent_delegation_challenge`

Issue the challenge an agent's root signs to delegate an agent, change its terms or revoke it: a human root's passkey signs webauthn_challenge, a machine root's TPM or Secure Enclave signs challenge_hex under the account-owner context. The account is the human's smart account or the account the machine's hardware key names. For delegate_agent and update_agent_terms the node collects each serving node's key and returns the completed terms as `delegation`; pass them back unchanged. For revoke_identity the target is revocation_target(agent_did, reason), and the account is the controller's.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account_address` | `String` | yes | The controller's smart account, hex |
| `operation` | `String` | yes | delegate_agent, update_agent_terms or revoke_identity |
| `delegation` | `Option<AgentTermsWire>` | no | The agent's terms (delegate_agent, update_agent_terms): controller_did, agent_name, delegation_scope, capabilities, serving_nodes as [{machine_did, operator_did}], min_distinct_operators, expires_at_ms |
| `agent_did` | `Option<String>` | no | The agent (update_agent_terms, revoke_identity) |
| `reason` | `Option<String>` | no | The reason the revocation records (revoke_identity); the approval covers it. Put the same reason in the RevokeIdentity transaction |
| `rotate_tokens` | `bool` | no | Also withdraw the agent's live access tokens (update_agent_terms) |
| `device_public_key` | `Option<String>` | no | For a machine delegated under the controller (delegate_agent): its hardware key, hex; it becomes the single serving node |
| `machine_id` | `Option<String>` | no | For a machine delegation: its machine id |

**Calls.** `tenzro_createCustodyChallenge` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "agent_delegation_challenge", "arguments": {"account_address": "0x…", "operation": "…"}}}
```

### `agent_remote_act`

As the agent (its access token), have this serving node sign one action of the agent's account on another chain, checked against the live grant there; returns the signature, the digest and the key and target proofs the account checks. Above the grant's cosign threshold a node of another operator signs too.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chain` | `String` | yes | The chain, CAIP-2 |
| `nonce` | `u64` | yes | The account's next action nonce on that chain |
| `action` | `PayRemoteAction` | yes | The action: target, selector, data (hex), amount, relay_refund (decimal strings) |

**Calls.** `tenzro_signRemoteAction`, `tenzro_buildRemoteAction` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "agent_remote_act", "arguments": {"chain": "…", "nonce": 0, "action": "…"}}}
```

### `agent_remote_grant`

As the agent (its access token), issue a grant on another chain: a budget of one asset for a limited time, held to the agent's terms and counted against its daily spend. Aptos takes exact grants only. Revoking, pausing, quarantining the agent or changing its terms voids every grant; a remote account stops at the latest when the grant expires.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chain` | `String` | yes | The chain, CAIP-2 (eip155:8453, solana:..., sui:mainnet, aptos:1, stellar:pubnet, cosmos:..., tvm:-239) |
| `grant` | `PayRemoteGrantRequest` | yes | The grant: caip19, budget, per_action_max, ttl_ms, targets [{target, selector}], payload_hash (exact grants), relay_fee_max |
| `step_up` | `Option<PayAgentTermsApproval>` | no | The controller's step-up approval, when the terms require one |

**Calls.** `tenzro_requestRemoteGrant` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "agent_remote_grant", "arguments": {"chain": "…", "grant": "…"}}}
```

### `agent_voucher`

As the calling delegated agent, have this serving node sign the agent's next cumulative voucher on a channel its wallet funded. The node signs only a voucher the ledger would honour now: this machine assigned in the agent's current terms, the agent not revoked or quarantined, the amount within the lock its terms counted at open.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `channel_id` | `String` | yes | Channel (escrow) id, 0x-prefixed 32-byte hex |
| `cumulative_amount` | `String` | yes | New cumulative amount owed on the channel, decimal u128 string |

**Calls.** `tenzro_agentVoucher` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "agent_voucher", "arguments": {"channel_id": "0x…", "cumulative_amount": "…"}}}
```

### `agent_wallet_consent`

The consent that makes an agent's account on an EVM chain the agentWallet of its ERC-8004 entry: the registry's EIP-712 AgentWalletSet digest and the approveHash action that approves it as the account's ERC-1271 signature (sign it with agent_remote_act), and the setAgentWallet calldata the entry's owner sends with an empty signature. The consent ends with the grant it was approved under.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `did` | `String` | yes | The agent's DID |
| `chain` | `String` | yes | The EVM chain, CAIP-2 (eip155:<id>) |
| `agent_id` | `u64` | yes | The ERC-8004 agentId |
| `owner` | `String` | yes | The address that owns the ERC-8004 entry |
| `deadline` | `u64` | yes | Unix seconds the consent expires; at most 300 s after it is used |
| `registry` | `Option<String>` | no | The identity registry; the canonical one when absent |

**Calls.** `tenzro_agentWalletConsent` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "agent_wallet_consent", "arguments": {"did": "did:tenzro:human:…", "chain": "…", "agent_id": 0, "owner": "0x…", "deadline": 0}}}
```

### `bridge_outbound`

Build the Bridge transaction that sends value out over a governed route, for the holder's wallet to sign client-side: TNZO, or a carried asset (asset: USDC) whose representation is burned here and released from the route's vault on the target chain. Completes the unsigned request with tx_type and gas_limit after the chain's shape checks and returns it with its signing payload. Sign on the holder's device, then send it with tenzro_sendRawTransaction. Nothing is signed or sent here.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `transaction` | `PayUnsignedTxRequest` | yes | The unsigned transaction request tenzro_sendRawTransaction takes (from, to, nonce, chain_id, gas_price, timestamp, valid_until), without tx_type, gas_limit, public_key or signature; the tool fills those two. `from` is the holder. |
| `target_chain` | `String` | yes | External chain the value goes to (a route's chain, e.g. base, ethereum, solana). |
| `recipient` | `String` | yes | Recipient account on the external chain (hex). |
| `amount` | `String` | yes | Amount in base units (decimal string): TNZO, the deposit asset over a deposit route, or the carried asset named by `asset`. |
| `asset` | `Option<String>` | no | A carried asset's symbol (USDC): its representation is burned here and the route's vault releases the token there. Omit to move TNZO. |

**Calls.** `tenzro_getSigningPayload` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "bridge_outbound", "arguments": {"transaction": "…", "target_chain": "…", "recipient": "…", "amount": 0}}}
```

### `call_rpc`

Invoke any JSON-RPC method this node serves, by name. The escape hatch for everything without a dedicated tool — discover names with list_rpc_methods first. Authorization is unchanged: the call runs behind the same access policy and default-deny classification as a direct JSON-RPC request, so this reaches exactly what your credentials already allow and nothing more.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `method` | `String` | yes | Exact JSON-RPC method name as returned by list_rpc_methods, e.g. `tenzro_previewServe` |
| `params` | `Option<JsonValue>` | no | The method's parameters as a JSON object. Omit for methods that take none |

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "call_rpc", "arguments": {"method": "…"}}}
```

### `can_transfer`

Check whether a token's rules allow a holder transfer now: halt, frozen balance, lockup and every eligibility rule (claims, jurisdiction, holder kind, holder and balance ceilings, agent Terms level). Returns allowed, and the refusal code and reason when not.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `token_id` | `String` | yes | Token id (64 hex) |
| `from` | `String` | yes | Sender account (hex) |
| `to` | `String` | yes | Recipient account (hex) |
| `amount` | `String` | yes | Amount in the token's smallest unit (decimal string) |

**Calls.** `tenzro_canTransfer` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "can_transfer", "arguments": {"token_id": "0x…", "from": "0x…", "to": "0x…", "amount": 0}}}
```

### `chat_by_intent`

Resolve an intent to a model and run the chat in one call. Selection walks the cross-model fallback chain, so the intent resolves as long as any model that satisfies it has a live offer, and dispatch is pinned to the offer that was scored — the price quoted is the price settled and the provider share goes to the address that offer named. The chosen decision is attached to the response under 'route'. Difficulty feedback for resolved and failed calls is recorded from the dispatch itself; report an escalation with record_route_outcome

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `use_case` | `String` | yes | Use case: 'chat', 'code', 'reasoning', 'research', 'summarize', 'extract', or 'embed'. Maps to a modality and biases quality tiering |
| `message` | `Option<String>` | no | The user message (simple single-turn shape). Provide this or 'messages' |
| `messages` | `Option<Vec<ChatMessageParam>>` | no | Chat turns as [{role, content}] (rich multi-turn shape). The last user turn is what difficulty scoring reads. Provide this or 'message' |
| `budget` | `Option<u128>` | no | Per-request cost cap in smallest TNZO unit. Accepts number or decimal string. Absent = no per-request cap. OptionalOption<String> |
| `optimize` | `Option<f64>` | no | Cost-quality knob in [0.0, 1.0]: 0.0 = cheapest acceptable, 1.0 = strongest. Optional |
| `quality_floor` | `Option<String>` | no | Reject any model below this tier: 'cheap' or 'strong'. Optional |
| `est_input_tokens` | `Option<u64>` | no | Estimated input tokens for cost estimation. Optional |
| `est_output_tokens` | `Option<u64>` | no | Estimated output tokens for cost estimation. Optional |
| `payer_did` | `Option<String>` | no | Payer DID. When set, the per-DID rolling-window budget gate is enforced. Optional |
| `payer_address` | `Option<String>` | no | Payer wallet address (hex). When set, the payer's on-chain TNZO balance is a hard ceiling and the call bills to it. Optional |
| `temperature` | `Option<f64>` | no | Temperature (0.0-2.0). Optional |
| `max_tokens` | `Option<u32>` | no | Maximum tokens to generate. Optional |
| `jurisdiction` | `Option<String>` | no | Comma-separated jurisdiction pin: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes and/or bloc tokens (e.g. 'DE,EU'), case-insensitive. The serving node must declare a matching attestation-bound locality claim or the request is refused. Optional |
| `jurisdiction_receipt` | `Option<String>` | no | Set to 'required' to fail the request unless the response carries a verifiable signed jurisdiction receipt. Optional |
| `max_p95_ms` | `Option<u64>` | no | p95 latency target in milliseconds; providers observed slower are skipped. Optional |
| `continuity` | `Option<String>` | no | Continuity level: 'none', 'standby' or 'hot_successor'. Above 'none' the network assigns a successor in the same jurisdiction that holds the session's KV cache and takes over if the provider fails; needs 'jurisdiction' and 'session_id'. Optional |
| `session_id` | `Option<String>` | no | The session the turns belong to, when continuity is above 'none'. Optional |

**Calls.** `tenzro_chatByIntent` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "chat_by_intent", "arguments": {"use_case": "…"}}}
```

Close a payment channel, signed by its payer. The highest voucher is claimed on-chain; the rest of the escrow returns to the payer when it expires.

| `signature` | `PayCompositeSignature` | yes | Payer's composite signature over the close request: {classical: {form, ...}, pq?} |
| `timestamp_ms` | `i64` | yes | Unix-millisecond timestamp the signature covers |

**Calls.** `tenzro_closePaymentChannel` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "close_payment_channel", "arguments": {"channel_id": "0x…", "public_key": "…", "signature": "…", "timestamp_ms": 0}}}
```

### `commit_challenge_vote`

Commit a committee vote on an inference challenge. Open to drawn committee seats only. `commit_hash` = compute_vote_commit(verdict, salt, challenge_id, voter); the verdict stays hidden until reveal. When committed stake reaches the 2f+1 threshold the challenge advances to the reveal phase. Mirrors tenzro_commitChallengeVote.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `challenge_id` | `String` | yes | Challenge id (UUID) being voted on. |
| `voter` | `String` | yes | Committee-member identity (validator address, hex). Must be a drawn committee seat. |
| `commit_hash` | `String` | yes | Vote commitment hash (hex) = compute_vote_commit(verdict, salt, challenge_id, voter). |
| `signature` | `String` | yes | Hex Ed25519 signature by the seat's consensus key over the commit, from tenzro_signChallengeVote on the voter's own node. |

**Calls.** `tenzro_commitChallengeVote` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "commit_challenge_vote", "arguments": {"challenge_id": "0x…", "voter": "…", "commit_hash": "0x…", "signature": "…"}}}
```

### `compute_price_feed`

Discover compute and model providers by observed price, latency and reliability. Every number comes from validators that routed real calls, not from what providers advertise. Filter by model, hardware class or region; rows are cheapest per compute-second first. Hardware class and region are the provider's own claims.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model_id` | `Option<String>` | no | Only this model id |
| `hardware_class` | `Option<String>` | no | Only this hardware class: cpu, consumer_gpu, datacenter_gpu or multi_accelerator |
| `region` | `Option<String>` | no | Only this region (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, case-insensitive) |
| `attested_only` | `Option<bool>` | no | Only providers observed by enough distinct validators to be attested |
| `limit` | `Option<u64>` | no | Maximum rows (default 100, max 1000) |

**Calls.** `tenzro_computePriceFeed` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "compute_price_feed", "arguments": {}}}
```

### `create_custody_challenge`

Ask the node for the challenge a passkey of the account's keystore must sign to authorize one custody change (grant_session_key, revoke_session_key, set_spending_limit, add_hardware_signer). Linking or unlinking passkeys and recovery are KeystoreUpdate transactions instead. A custody change needs proof of control from a device already on the account — the account address is a public identifier, not a credential. The challenge is single-use, time-bounded, and bound to this account and operation.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account_address` | `String` | yes | Smart account being changed (0x-prefixed 20-byte address) |
| `operation` | `String` | yes | One of: enroll_passkey, grant_session_key, revoke_session_key, set_spending_limit, add_hardware_signer |
| `target_hex` | `Option<String>` | no | The operation's subject, hex — the credential being revoked, the session key being withdrawn |

**Calls.** `tenzro_createCustodyChallenge` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "create_custody_challenge", "arguments": {"account_address": "0x…", "operation": "…"}}}
```

### `create_escrow`

Create an on-chain escrow paid from the calling agent's own wallet. The agent acts with its access token: this node, one of its serving nodes, checks the action against the agent's terms on chain (operation create_escrow, counterparty, per-transaction and daily limits) and signs it for the agent only when it is within them; the VM checks it again. Returns the escrow_id.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `payee` | `String` | yes | Hex-encoded 32-byte payee address (receives funds on release) |
| `amount_wei` | `String` | yes | Amount in wei to hold in escrow as a decimal string (1 TNZO = 10^18 wei). |
| `release_condition` | `String` | yes | Release condition: 'provider_signature' \| 'consumer_signature' \| 'both_signatures' \| 'timeout' \| 'custom' |
| `timeout_secs` | `Option<u64>` | no | Seconds until the agent's wallet may refund what remains (default 3600) |

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "create_escrow", "arguments": {"payee": "0x…", "amount_wei": "…", "release_condition": "…"}}}
```

### `create_passkey_session`

Create a pending browser-launch passkey ceremony session (enroll a new account, add a device credential, or sign over an op hash). Returns a session id and the node-served /auth/passkey URL to open in a browser; the browser runs navigator.credentials.create()/get() and the caller polls get_passkey_session until the session reaches a terminal status.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `String` | yes | Ceremony kind: "enroll" (new account), "add" (device credential on an existing account), or "sign" (verify an assertion over an op hash). |
| `display_name` | `Option<String>` | no | Enroll: optional display name for the new identity. |
| `salt` | `u64` | no | Enroll: CREATE2 salt (defaults to 0). |
| `account_address` | `Option<String>` | no | Add + Sign: target smart-account address (hex). |
| `label` | `Option<String>` | no | Add: display label for the new credential. |
| `op_hash_hex` | `Option<String>` | no | Sign: 32-byte op hash (hex) the assertion must attest to. |
| `ml_dsa_signature_hex` | `Option<String>` | no | Sign: the hardware ML-DSA-65 leg (hex) over the composite representative of the op hash (context UserOperation), for accounts with a hardware ML-DSA-65 key enrolled. |

**Calls.** `tenzro_createPasskeySession` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "create_passkey_session", "arguments": {"kind": "…"}}}
```

### `create_payment_challenge`

Create a payment challenge for a protected resource. Supports three protocols: - 'mpp' (Machine Payments Protocol): Session-based streaming payments, ideal for per-token AI inference billing - 'x402' (HTTP 402): Stateless one-shot payments, ideal for API calls and data downloads - 'native': Direct TNZO transfer on the Tenzro ledger

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `protocol` | `String` | yes | Payment protocol: 'mpp' (Machine Payments Protocol — session-based streaming), 'x402' (Coinbase HTTP 402 — stateless one-shot), or 'native' (direct TNZO transfer) |
| `resource` | `String` | yes | Resource URL or identifier being paid for (e.g. /api/inference, /api/data/query) |
| `amount` | `u128` | yes | Payment amount in smallest unit (e.g. 100 = 0.000100 USDC for x402, or TNZO base units for native) |
| `asset` | `String` | yes | Payment asset: 'USDC', 'USDT', or 'TNZO' |
| `recipient` | `String` | yes | Hex-encoded recipient address |
| `app_id` | `Option<String>` | no | Registered app_id for developer-margin attribution. The amount is marked up by the app's margin and the margin is carved out to the app wallet at settlement. |

**Calls.** `tenzro_createPaymentChallenge` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "create_payment_challenge", "arguments": {"protocol": "…", "resource": "…", "amount": 0, "asset": "…", "recipient": "…"}}}
```

### `create_zk_proof`

Prove a `settlement` statement (knowledge of the 32-byte service result whose SHA3-256 under the settlement domain is the public digest) in every proof system. Returns the public inputs [digest, binding] and one proof per system.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `circuit_id` | `String` | yes | Circuit identifier — 'settlement' (identity proofs are made by the key holder, never by a node) |
| `witness` | `ZkSettlementWitness` | yes | JSON object {"witness": 32-byte hex service result, "binding": 32-byte hex request binding} |

**Calls.** `tenzro_createZkProof` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "create_zk_proof", "arguments": {"circuit_id": "0x…", "witness": "…"}}}
```

### `da_availability`

Read DA committee availability scores (0-1000, +1 per passed possession challenge, -5 silence or honest not-held, -25 bad proof). Pass an address for one member's score, omit for all scored members lowest-first.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `address` | `Option<String>` | no | Optional 0x-prefixed member address. Omit to list every scored member, lowest score first |

**Calls.** `tenzro_daAvailability` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "da_availability", "arguments": {}}}
```

### `da_challenge`

Challenge a DA committee member to prove current possession of its Red Stuff sliver for a blob commitment. The target must return the full sliver plus a nonce-bound Ed25519 signature; the challenger re-verifies the sliver against the commitment. The outcome (passed / failed_no_response / failed_not_held / failed_bad_proof) feeds the target's rolling availability score. Validator-only.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `commitment` | `String` | yes | 0x-prefixed 32-byte blob commitment whose sliver custody should be challenged |
| `target_index` | `u64` | yes | Committee index of the member to challenge |

**Calls.** `tenzro_daChallenge` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "da_challenge", "arguments": {"commitment": "…", "target_index": 0}}}
```

### `da_committee`

Show the current DA committee roster: each member's index, address, whether it is the local node, and its availability score if it has ever been challenged.

**Input.** None.

**Calls.** `tenzro_daCommittee` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "da_committee", "arguments": {}}}
```

List blob commitments known to the local DA committee store, with the locally-held sliver index (if any) and the availability certificate (attesting member indices, quorum, root, timestamp) when one is held.

**Input.** None.

**Calls.** `tenzro_daListBlobs` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "da_list_blobs", "arguments": {}}}
```

### `da_list_challenges`

List resolved DA possession-challenge records, newest-first. Each record carries the blob commitment, target member index + address, nonce, timestamps, and outcome.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | `Option<u32>` | no | Max challenge records to return, newest-first (default 100) |

**Calls.** `tenzro_daListChallenges` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "da_list_challenges", "arguments": {}}}
```

### `decide`

Answer typed questions about a text with a decision model, in one forward pass and without generating text. Each question is yes/no ('noul': probability of yes), a choice (probability of every option and the most probable) or a score (expected level on a 2 to 10 level scale), with a calibrated confidence. Up to 64 questions per request. Returns the answers in request order, the units billed, the cost, the settlement and the signed task receipt.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model_id` | `String` | yes | Loaded decision model id (e.g. 'laya') |
| `state` | `JsonValue` | yes | What to decide about: text, or any JSON value (an email, a ticket, a record) |
| `questions` | `Vec<DecisionQuestionParam>` | yes | 1 to 64 questions, answered in this order |
| `verification` | `Option<String>` | no | Verification level: none, receipt, optimistic or tee |
| `provider` | `Option<String>` | no | Serve on this provider's offer (payee address, hex). Without it, a model this node does not serve goes to a provider offering it |

**Calls.** `tenzro_decide` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "decide", "arguments": {"model_id": "0x…", "state": "…", "questions": []}}}
```

### `delegate_agent`

Create a delegated agent from the completed terms and its root's approval (a human's passkey or a machine's hardware key). Returns the agent's identity, its watch-only wallet and its serving nodes. The agent signs in with its own key (tenzro_issueAccessToken); within the approved terms it acts with no further approval.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `delegation` | `PayAgentTerms` | yes | The completed terms the challenge returned, unchanged |
| `authorization` | `PayRootApproval` | yes | The root's approval of the challenge: a passkey assertion ({challenge_id, credential_id_hex, assertion, ml_dsa_signature_hex}) for a human root, or {challenge_id, signature} with the composite hardware signature over challenge_hex under the account-owner context for a machine root |

**Calls.** `tenzro_onboardDelegatedAgent` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "delegate_agent", "arguments": {"delegation": "…", "authorization": "…"}}}
```

| `provider` | `Option<String>` | no | Serve on this provider's offer (payee address, hex). Without it, a model this node does not serve goes to a provider offering it |

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "detect", "arguments": {"model_id": "0x…", "image_base64": "…"}}}
```

### `enroll_passkey`

Enroll a passkey-bound smart account. Consumes a WebAuthn registration credential (P-256 public key + opaque credential ID) with proof of possession (an assertion over the webauthn_challenge of an enroll_passkey custody challenge), registers the human identity it derives, and returns the account it derives with that account's keystore and, before the account's first change, the anchor its first KeystoreUpdate carries. Nothing about the account is stored by the node; the signing key never leaves the user's device.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `display_name` | `Option<String>` | no |  |
| `passkey_public_key_hex` | `String` | yes |  |
| `credential_id_hex` | `String` | yes |  |
| `authorization` | `Option<CustodyAuthorizationWire>` | no | For a further wallet (salt above 0): proof the caller holds the passkey, challenge_id, credential_id_hex and the assertion over the webauthn_challenge of an enroll_passkey custody challenge |
| `registration_authenticator_data_hex` | `Option<String>` | no | The registration's authenticatorData, hex, as navigator.credentials.create() returned it; required for a first wallet |
| `rp_id` | `Option<String>` | no | The relying party the passkey is registered on: the wallet provider's domain |
| `salt` | `u64` | no |  |

**Calls.** `tenzro_enrollPasskey` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "enroll_passkey", "arguments": {"passkey_public_key_hex": "…", "credential_id_hex": "…"}}}
```

### `exchange_token`

RFC 8693 OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange. Mint a narrower child JWT from a parent JWT, bound to a different DPoP key with a strict subset of the parent's RAR grants and AAP capabilities. The child token's controller_did is set to the parent's sub, extending the act-chain by one hop. Subset enforcement is performed by the AS; over-scoped requests are rejected.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subject_token` | `String` | yes | Parent JWT (the `subject_token` per RFC 8693). The AS validates its signature, exp, and revocation state before issuing the child token. |
| `child_bearer_did` | `String` | yes | DID that will be the `sub` of the new child JWT — typically a delegated agent or sub-agent in the act-chain |
| `child_dpop_jkt` | `String` | yes | RFC 7638 JWK thumbprint of the child holder's Ed25519 public key. The child token is DPoP-bound to this key. |
| `requested_rar` | `RarAuthorizationDetails` | yes | RFC 9396 typed scope envelope the child should carry. Must be a strict subset of the parent's authorization_details. An object `{details: [...]}`. |
| `requested_aap_capabilities` | `Vec<AapCapabilityWire>` | yes | AAP `aap_capabilities` claim list — per-action constraints layered over RAR. Must be a subset of the parent's capabilities. |
| `requested_ttl_secs` | `Option<u64>` | no | Optional TTL override for the child token in seconds. Clamped to the engine's max_ttl_secs and the parent's remaining lifetime. |

**Calls.** `tenzro_exchangeToken` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "exchange_token", "arguments": {"subject_token": "…", "child_bearer_did": "did:tenzro:human:…", "child_dpop_jkt": "…", "requested_rar": "…", "requested_aap_capabilities": []}}}
```

### `file_inference_challenge`

File a challenge against a stored inference commitment. Open to any caller; the model and provider are read from the stored envelope so filings cannot misattribute. Returns the filed challenge record with its challenge_id. Mirrors tenzro_fileInferenceChallenge.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `commitment_hash` | `String` | yes | Commitment hash (hex, with or without 0x prefix) being disputed. Unknown hashes are rejected. |
| `challenger` | `String` | yes | Challenger identity (DID or address). Recorded verbatim on the challenge. |
| `reason` | `Option<String>` | no | Optional free-text reason for the dispute. |

**Calls.** `tenzro_fileInferenceChallenge` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "file_inference_challenge", "arguments": {"commitment_hash": "0x…", "challenger": "…"}}}
```

### `finalize_challenge`

Finalize an inference challenge by tallying revealed committee votes weighted by stake. No administrator decides: the verdict is the committee's. Idempotent: a decided challenge returns unchanged. An upheld verdict decrements the provider's reputation (response carries reputation_penalized); slashing a compute bond is the consensus InferenceFault path. A challenge with no quorum closes as dismissed once its reveal window has passed. Mirrors tenzro_finalizeChallenge.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `challenge_id` | `String` | yes | Challenge id (UUID) to finalize by tallying revealed committee votes. |

**Calls.** `tenzro_finalizeChallenge` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "finalize_challenge", "arguments": {"challenge_id": "0x…"}}}
```

### `forecast`

Run a univariate timeseries forecast on a registered model. Pass `history` (most-recent-last context series), `horizon` (steps ahead), and optional `quantiles` (e.g. [0.1, 0.5, 0.9]) and `frequency_seconds`. Returns point forecasts and (when supported) quantile bands.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model_id` | `String` | yes | Registered forecast model id (e.g. 'timesfm-2.5-200m') |
| `history` | `Vec<f32>` | yes | Univariate context series (most-recent-last). Non-empty. |
| `horizon` | `u32` | yes | Forecast horizon (steps ahead). Must be > 0. |
| `quantiles` | `Option<Vec<f32>>` | no | Optional output quantile levels in (0,1) (e.g. [0.1, 0.5, 0.9]). Defaults to model-native quantiles. |
| `frequency_seconds` | `Option<u64>` | no | Optional sampling frequency in seconds (used by frequency-aware models) |
| `verification` | `Option<String>` | no | Verification level: none, receipt, optimistic or tee |
| `provider` | `Option<String>` | no | Serve on this provider's offer (payee address, hex). Without it, a model this node does not serve goes to a provider offering it |

**Calls.** `tenzro_forecast` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "forecast", "arguments": {"model_id": "0x…", "history": [], "horizon": 0}}}
```

### `forget_identity`

TDIP/GDPR Article 17 right-to-erasure. Hard-deletes a previously revoked identity from the registry and persistent storage. The DID must already be in `Revoked` status — call `revoke_did` (RPC) first, allow cascading revocation to propagate, then call this. Distinct from revoke (logical delete). Administrators only.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `did` | `String` | yes | DID to resolve (e.g. did:tenzro:human:uuid or did:tenzro:machine:controller:uuid) |

**Calls.** `tenzro_forgetIdentity` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "forget_identity", "arguments": {"did": "did:tenzro:human:…"}}}
```

**Calls.** `tenzro_getBridgeRoute` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "get_bridge_route", "arguments": {"adapter": "…", "source_chain": "…"}}}
```

### `get_checkpoint_certificate`

Get a checkpoint certificate: the portable proof that a range of heights is final. Returns the encoded certificate (checkpoint plus a quorum of seat signatures) and the session certificates it names, each signed by the seat's hardware key. Verifiable with no Tenzro node against the epoch's committee (tenzro_getCommittee). Omit index for the latest. With decode, also the signers read against that committee: each one's index, account, seats, stake, key fingerprint and session digest, with the signed and total seats and the quorum.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `index` | `Option<u64>` | no | Checkpoint index; omit for the latest certificate |
| `decode` | `Option<bool>` | no | Also return the signer set decoded against the epoch's committee |

**Calls.** `tenzro_getCheckpointCertificate` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "get_checkpoint_certificate", "arguments": {}}}
```

### `get_compute_bond`

Read compute bonds — the bond inference faults, frozen SLA verdicts and proven policy violations are slashed from. Pass provider_did for one bond, or omit it to list every bond on the node. Always returns the node's minimum bond and withdrawal cooldown so a caller can see what admission requires.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `provider_did` | `Option<String>` | no | Provider DID the bond is posted against (e.g. did:tenzro:machine:...). If omitted, lists every compute bond on the node |

**Calls.** `tenzro_getComputeBond` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "get_compute_bond", "arguments": {}}}
```

### `get_treasury_payouts`

Get every disbursement of treasury sponsorship and grants, oldest first: recipient, amount, class (validator, provider, developer, contributor, community), the proposal that paid it and the milestone or verified hours it was paid against; the total per class; and the governed caps. With an address, whether it is an approved operator or grantee, the criteria it was approved on, and the total it has been paid. All payouts are existing treasury TNZO, one governance proposal each.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `address` | `Option<String>` | no | Hex-encoded address to read the approval status and total received of |
| `offset` | `Option<u64>` | no | Disbursements to skip, oldest first (default 0) |
| `limit` | `Option<u64>` | no | Most disbursements to return (default 100, at most 100) |

**Calls.** `tenzro_getTreasuryPayouts` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "get_treasury_payouts", "arguments": {}}}
```

### `governance_get`

Read governance state from consensus: a proposal with its tally, the last enacted change of a network policy, a tranched grant, a binary's upgrade readiness, or a proposal's governance receipt (its records with state proofs under a certified checkpoint, for offline verification with `tenzro governance receipt --verify`).

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `String` | yes | What to read: 'proposal', 'policy', 'grant', 'readiness' or 'receipt'. |
| `id` | `String` | yes | Proposal or grant id (64 hex); a binary's SHA-256 (64 hex) for readiness; the policy kind for a policy (economic_policy, adaptive_burn_config, supply_targets, protocol_upgrade). |

**Calls.** `tenzro_getProposal`, `tenzro_getPolicy`, `tenzro_getGrant`, `tenzro_getUpgradeReadiness`, `tenzro_getGovernanceReceipt` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "governance_get", "arguments": {"kind": "…", "id": "0x…"}}}
```

### `introspect_token`

RFC 7662 OAuth 2.0 Token Introspection. Ask the AS whether a token is currently active and, if so, return its full claim set (RAR authorization_details, AAP aap_* claims, cnf, controller_did, etc.). Per RFC 7662 §2.2 a failed validation returns `{active: false}` with no other fields — the AS does not leak why the token is inactive.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | `String` | yes | JWT to introspect. The AS returns `{active: true, ...claims}` on success or `{active: false}` per RFC 7662 §2.2 if the token is unknown, expired, or revoked. |

**Calls.** `tenzro_introspectToken` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "introspect_token", "arguments": {"token": "…"}}}
```

### `issue_access_token`

Answer a sign-in challenge and receive a short-lived ES256 access token bound to the challenge's DPoP key. `proof` is `{kind: "passkey", account_address, credential_id, authenticator_data, client_data_json, signature}` (base64url) or `{kind: "device", public_key, signature}` (hex). Optional `credentials` are KYA credentials about the DID. Returns the token, its lifetime and the method classes the policy admits the DID to.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `challenge_id` | `String` | yes | The challenge id from access_challenge |
| `proof` | `AccessSignInProof` | yes | The passkey or hardware-key answer to the challenge |
| `credentials` | `Option<Vec<KyaCredential>>` | no | KYA credentials about the DID, for policies that require one |

**Calls.** `tenzro_issueAccessToken` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "issue_access_token", "arguments": {"challenge_id": "0x…", "proof": "…"}}}
```

### `join_as_participant`

Join the Tenzro Network as a MicroNode — a zero-install full participant. Provisions a TDIP decentralized identity (DID) and a wallet bound to a key you already hold — a passkey for a person, a TPM / Secure Enclave key for an agent. Grants access to all 10 network capabilities: inference, payments, agent collaboration, MCP tools, task execution, chain queries, smart contracts, TEE services, cross-chain bridge, and governance. Works from any entry point: Claude, ClawBot, MCP, A2A, SDK, API, CLI, or app. No binary installation required; you do need a key of your own, which the node never sees the private half of.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `display_name` | `Option<String>` | no | Display name for this participant (human-readable, optional) |
| `public_key` | `String` | yes | Hex public key of the key that owns this participant — the passkey \ (human) or the TPM / Secure Enclave key (agent/bot). Required: the \ node does not generate keys on your behalf. |
| `credential_id` | `Option<String>` | no | Hex passkey credential id. Required when participant_type is \ 'human'; omitted for an autonomous 'agent' / 'bot'. |
| `origin` | `Option<String>` | no | Entry point: 'mcp' \| 'claude' \| 'clawbot' \| 'a2a' \| 'sdk' \| 'api' \| 'cli' \| 'app' |
| `participant_type` | `Option<String>` | no | Participant type: 'human' \| 'agent' \| 'bot' |

**Calls.** `tenzro_joinAsMicroNode` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "join_as_participant", "arguments": {"public_key": "…"}}}
```

### `list_payments`

List consensus payment records in chain order, read from the chain's event index: native, proven and attested payments, optionally only those to a payee, from a payer, by a delegated agent, of one class or asset. Each entry carries its event cursor and, with proofs, the event's proof; `settlement` (the burn and treasury leg its transaction declared) and `work` (the call this node recorded for it: model, units, serving node, hardware tier, latency; node-local), each null when unknown. Pass the returned cursor back as from_cursor to continue.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `payee` | `Option<String>` | no | Only payments to this payee, 32-byte hex address |
| `payer` | `Option<String>` | no | Only payments from this payer |
| `agent_did` | `Option<String>` | no | Only payments made by this delegated agent DID |
| `class` | `Option<String>` | no | Only this record class: native, proven or attested |
| `asset` | `Option<String>` | no | Only this asset |
| `from_cursor` | `Option<String>` | no | Continue after this event cursor (the cursor a previous call returned) |
| `from_height` | `Option<u64>` | no | Start at this block height |
| `limit` | `Option<u64>` | no | Most records |
| `proofs` | `Option<bool>` | no | Include each record's event proof |

**Calls.** `tenzro_listPayments` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "list_payments", "arguments": {}}}
```

Each carries its coarse region (country code or wide region; omitted when undeclared), jurisdiction, served models, the live load of each model (in flight, admission ceiling, warm-up queue depth, state) with the time it was read, its hardware tier when detected, and the kind of hardware its identity key is held in (tpm, enclave, delegated_tpm or passkey) as it declared it. | Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model_id` | `String` | yes | Model id to register the clip-level encoder under |

| `num_frames` | `Option<u32>` | no | Frames to extract per clip, evenly spaced (default 8, clamped to 1..128) |
| `visibility` | `Option<String>` | no | Visibility override: 'public', 'gated' or 'private'. Omit to follow the node's visibility. |

**Calls.** `tenzro_loadVideoModel` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "load_video_model", "arguments": {"model_id": "0x…", "vision_model_id": "0x…"}}}
```

Each entry carries id, hf_repo, pipeline_class, kinds, default resolution and steps, min_vram_gb, license, and expert_pair. A non-null expert_pair means the denoising schedule splits across two experts.

### `media_gen_render`

Render one generative-media output now, on this node or on a provider serving the model. The answer carries what its signed receipt commits to (mime, output_sha256, output_bytes, the perceptual fingerprint and the tolerance a re-render must agree within), the receipt, the price, and output_blake3, under which the output is fetched with tenzro_iroh_fetchBlob. At verification 'optimistic' a share of renders is re-executed on another provider and a disagreement is filed as an inference fault.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model_id` | `String` | yes | Catalog model id of a media model served whole (not split across two experts) |
| `kind` | `String` | yes | Media kind: 'text2image' \| 'image2image' \| 'text2video' \| 'image2video' \| 'text2audio' \| 'image23d' \| 'action_policy' \| 'world_model' |
| `params` | `MediaGenParamsInput` | yes | MediaGenParams object: prompt, width, height, steps, guidance_scale; for video num_frames and fps; for action_policy action_chunks; for world_model num_frames, fps and session_hold_secs; for image23d an empty prompt, the reference image's width and height and optionally voxel_resolution (the output is a GLB); a seed (a render is seeded, so another provider can re-render it); inputs = ordered [{role, hash}] naming each input by SHA-256, role one of first_frame \| last_frame \| reference \| edit_source \| mask \| observation |
| `inputs_base64` | `Option<Vec<String>>` | no | Base64 bytes of each input params.inputs names, in the same order |
| `verification` | `Option<String>` | no | Verification the answer must carry: 'none' \| 'receipt' \| 'optimistic' \| 'tee' |
| `provider` | `Option<String>` | no | Hex address of a provider to render on, from its announced offer |

**Calls.** `tenzro_mediaGen_render` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "media_gen_render", "arguments": {"model_id": "0x…", "kind": "…", "params": "…"}}}
```

### `mirror_settlement`

Record a settlement, given as its interaction record, on other chains in parallel. A self-contained mirror writes the canonical settlement bytes, so the record stays readable with no Tenzro node in existence — the only form that survives the Tenzro Ledger losing state, which matters while Tenzro is on testnet. A digest-only mirror proves a payload you already hold is the one that settled but cannot say what settled. Returns one Bridge transaction per target for the caller to sign in hardware and submit; each lands independently, so partial success is the normal case.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `interaction` | `PayInteractionProvenance` | yes | The interaction record of the settlement to mirror. |
| `chains` | `Vec<String>` | yes | Chains to mirror onto — CAIP-2 ids (`eip155:8453`) or adapter chain names (`base`). Both are accepted. |
| `digest_only` | `bool` | no | Write only the digest rather than the full settlement bytes. Cheaper, but the record then does not survive the Tenzro Ledger losing state. |

**Calls.** `tenzro_mirrorSettlement` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "mirror_settlement", "arguments": {"interaction": "…", "chains": []}}}
```

### `moe_forward`

Run a distributed MoE forward for one layer: gate-route the hidden-state batch locally, fan expert sub-batches out to holders (local runtime, iroh tenzro/moe ALPN, or HTTP JSON-RPC), and gather the gate-weighted combined outputs. hidden_states and outputs are base64 of little-endian f32 bytes.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model_id` | `String` | yes | Catalog model id |
| `layer` | `u32` | yes | Layer index |
| `d_model` | `u32` | yes | Hidden dimension per token |
| `hidden_states` | `String` | yes | Base64 of little-endian f32 hidden states, n_tokens x d_model |
| `top_k` | `Option<u32>` | no | Experts per token; defaults to the catalog experts_per_token for the model |
| `allow_cold` | `Option<bool>` | no | Allow dispatch to experts that are not warm-resident (default false) |

**Calls.** `tenzro_moeForward` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "moe_forward", "arguments": {"model_id": "0x…", "layer": 0, "d_model": 0, "hidden_states": "…"}}}
```

### `moe_prepare_experts`

Slice a catalog MoE checkpoint into per-expert safetensors blobs (and optionally the layer gate), optionally block-quantizing each projection (q4_k_m / q8_0 / q4_k / q6_k preset, or a per-projection gate/up/down mix), and publish them as tenzro://blob content so holders can load them. Runs asynchronously; returns a job_id to poll with moe_prepare_status. Omit experts to prepare every expert in the layer.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model_id` | `String` | yes | Catalog model id (must be a MoE entry) |
| `layer` | `u32` | yes | Layer index to prepare experts for |
| `experts` | `Option<Vec<u32>>` | no | Expert indices to prepare; omit or empty to prepare every expert in the layer |
| `include_gate` | `Option<bool>` | no | Publish the layer's gating-network blob alongside the experts (default true) |
| `quant` | `Option<MoeQuantParam>` | no | Block-quantization: a preset string (q4_k_m / q8_0 / q4_k / q6_k) or a per-projection object like {"gate":"q4_k","up":"q4_k","down":"q6_k"}. Omit for dense f32 blobs. |

**Calls.** `tenzro_moePrepareExperts` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "moe_prepare_experts", "arguments": {"model_id": "0x…", "layer": 0}}}
```

### `moe_prepare_status`

Poll the state of an expert-preparation job started by moe_prepare_experts. Returns the job's model_id, layer, state (running / done / error), any error, and the prepared per-expert tenzro://blob URIs when done.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `job_id` | `String` | yes | Job id returned by moe_prepare_experts |

**Calls.** `tenzro_moePrepareStatus` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "moe_prepare_status", "arguments": {"job_id": "0x…"}}}
```

### `payment_refund`

Build the Payment transaction by which a payee returns part or all of a native payment to its payer, in the asset it was paid in (refunds on one record never exceed what it paid), for the payee's wallet to sign client-side. Returns the completed request and its signing payload, as bridge_outbound does. Nothing is signed or sent here.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `transaction` | `PayUnsignedTxRequest` | yes | The unsigned transaction request tenzro_sendRawTransaction takes (from, to, nonce, chain_id, gas_price, timestamp, valid_until), without tx_type, gas_limit, public_key or signature; the tool fills those two. `from` is the payee. |
| `pay_ref` | `String` | yes | The payment record's pay_ref (32-byte hex). |
| `amount` | `String` | yes | Amount returned to the payer, in the paid asset's smallest unit (decimal string). |

**Calls.** `tenzro_getSigningPayload` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "payment_refund", "arguments": {"transaction": "…", "pay_ref": "…", "amount": 0}}}
```

### `payment_set_split`

Build the Payment transaction by which a payee sets the standing split rule every payment it receives is divided by after the fee (rule null clears it), for the payee's wallet to sign client-side. Returns the completed request and its signing payload, as bridge_outbound does. Nothing is signed or sent here.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `transaction` | `PayUnsignedTxRequest` | yes | The unsigned transaction request tenzro_sendRawTransaction takes (from, to, nonce, chain_id, gas_price, timestamp, valid_until), without tx_type, gas_limit, public_key or signature; the tool fills those two. `from` is the payee. |
| `rule` | `Option<PaySplitRule>` | no | The split rule in the split engine's form ({version, lines}, as tenzro_getPayeeSplit returns it); null clears the payee's rule. |

**Calls.** `tenzro_getSigningPayload` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "payment_set_split", "arguments": {"transaction": "…"}}}
```

### `query_events`

Query a range of the chain's events, each with its proof against a certified checkpoint. Page with the returned cursor (pass it back as from_cursor).

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filter` | `Option<EventFilterInput>` | no | Event filter: {event_types: ['log' \| 'transaction_included'], addresses: [20-byte hex], topics: [null \| hex \| [hex]], from_block, to_block} |
| `from_cursor` | `Option<String>` | no | Resume after this cursor (height:tx_index:event_index) |
| `from_height` | `Option<u64>` | no | Start at this height (instead of from_cursor) |
| `to_cursor` | `Option<String>` | no | Stop at this cursor, inclusive |
| `limit` | `Option<u64>` | no | Most events to return (default 100, max 1000) |
| `completeness` | `Option<bool>` | no | Also prove the page left out nothing the filter selects: the block-index entries of every block it covered (at most 256 heights a page) |
| `anchor_index` | `Option<u64>` | no | Checkpoint index every proof ends at (default: the latest certified) |

**Calls.** `tenzro_queryEvents` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "query_events", "arguments": {}}}
```

| Field | Type | Required | Description |

| `adapter` | `String` | yes | Route transport: ccip, ibc, deposit or contract |

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "quote_bridge_fee_in_tnzo", "arguments": {"adapter": "…", "dest_chain": "…", "native_fee_smallest_unit": "…"}}}
```

### `quote_inference`

Price one inference request at every provider serving a model, cheapest first: each provider's announced rate card applied to the request's billable units (input_tokens, output_tokens, cached tokens, image tokens, audio/video ms, ...), plus the governed surcharge for the verification level (none, receipt, optimistic, tee). Only providers that can serve at that level are quoted. Each offer carries the provider's region and the model's live load.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | `String` | yes | Model id |
| `units` | `Option<ModelsUnits>` | no | Billable units of the request, e.g. {"input_tokens": 800, "output_tokens": 200}; omitted units are zero |
| `verification` | `Option<String>` | no | Verification level: none (default), receipt, optimistic or tee |
| `provider` | `Option<String>` | no | Only this provider's address |

**Calls.** `tenzro_quoteInference` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "quote_inference", "arguments": {"model": "…"}}}
```

### `quote_resource`

What a USD price (micro-units) costs in TNZO now, with the settlement fee it pays, as a payment settled now counts it. Returns {usd_e6, unit, rate_epoch, assets: [{asset, amount, fee, fee_asset, rate_epoch}]}.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `usd_e6` | `u64` | yes | The price in USD micro-units (1 USD = 1000000) |

**Calls.** `tenzro_quotePayment` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "quote_resource", "arguments": {"usd_e6": 0}}}
```

### `record_route_outcome`

Report how a routed call turned out so per-cluster error rates reflect what happened rather than only what the catalog declares. In practice this carries 'escalated' — the outcome only the caller knows, because it means you took the answer to a stronger model; 'resolved' and 'failed' are already recorded by chat_by_intent from the dispatch itself. Reporting is advisory: retained=false means the node has no difficulty index wired, so the feedback was accepted and discarded

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model_id` | `String` | yes | The model that served the call. Take it from the routing decision's model_id |
| `cluster` | `u32` | yes | The difficulty cluster the request landed in. Take it from the routing decision's 'cluster' |
| `outcome` | `String` | yes | How the call turned out: 'resolved' (answered acceptably), 'escalated' (you took the answer to a stronger model), or 'failed' (no usable answer) |

**Calls.** `tenzro_recordRouteOutcome` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "record_route_outcome", "arguments": {"model_id": "0x…", "cluster": 0, "outcome": "…"}}}
```

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `escrow_id` | `String` | yes | 32-byte escrow ID (hex, with or without 0x prefix) |

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "refund_escrow", "arguments": {"escrow_id": "0x…"}}}
```

### `register_identity`

Register a human or machine identity on the Tenzro Decentralized Identity Protocol (TDIP). Human identities are self-sovereign; machine identities require a controller DID and receive a delegation scope. The node submits the RegisterIdentity transaction that replicates the identity and returns its tx_hash; when it cannot, it records nothing and returns the error

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identity_type` | `String` | yes | Identity type: 'human' or 'machine' |
| `display_name` | `String` | yes | Display name for the identity |
| `controller_did` | `Option<String>` | no | Controller DID (required for machine identities, e.g. did:tenzro:human:uuid) |
| `public_key` | `String` | yes | Hex public key of the key that owns this identity — the passkey \ (human) or the TPM / Secure Enclave key (machine). Required: this \ node does not generate keys on your behalf. |
| `credential_id` | `Option<String>` | no | Hex passkey credential id (human identities only). An autonomous \ machine has no passkey and omits this. |
| `did_envelope` | `Option<String>` | no | Hex DID envelope from the controller DID, bound to method \ tenzro_registerIdentity and these parameters. Required for machine \ identities: the machine draws on its controller's admission quota \ and delegation scope, so the controller has to sign for it. |

**Calls.** `tenzro_registerIdentity` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "register_identity", "arguments": {"identity_type": "…", "display_name": "…", "public_key": "…"}}}
```

### `release_escrow`

Release an escrow the calling agent's wallet funded: what remains goes to the payee. Acts with the agent's access token, within its terms (operation release_escrow).

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `escrow_id` | `String` | yes | 32-byte escrow ID (hex, with or without 0x prefix) |
| `proof_data_hex` | `Option<String>` | no | Optional hex-encoded proof bytes |

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "release_escrow", "arguments": {"escrow_id": "0x…"}}}
```

### `rerank`

Score documents against a query with a reranker; either side may carry text, a picture and a video with a vision-language reranker. Returns the documents best first with their relevance scores, the units billed (pairs and tokens), the cost and, at a verification level other than none, a signed receipt over the request and the scores.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model_id` | `String` | yes | Loaded reranker id |
| `query` | `EmbedInputParam` | yes | The query: a string, or an object with `text`, `image` (base64 PNG/JPEG/WebP) and/or `video` (base64 frames in order); pictures and video need a vision-language reranker (e.g. 'qwen3-vl-reranker-2b'). |
| `documents` | `Vec<EmbedInputParam>` | yes | Documents to score (1 to 1000), each in the same shape as the query |
| `top_n` | `Option<u64>` | no | Return only the best N |
| `return_documents` | `Option<bool>` | no | Include each document as given in the answer |
| `verification` | `Option<String>` | no | Verification level: none, receipt, optimistic or tee |
| `provider` | `Option<String>` | no | Serve on this provider's offer (payee address, hex). Without it, a model this node does not serve goes to a provider offering it |

**Calls.** `tenzro_rerank` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "rerank", "arguments": {"model_id": "0x…", "query": "…", "documents": []}}}
```

### `reveal_challenge_vote`

Reveal a previously committed committee vote. `(verdict, salt)` must reproduce the earlier commit hash. verdict=true means the commitment did not verify (upholds the challenge). Mirrors tenzro_revealChallengeVote.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `challenge_id` | `String` | yes | Challenge id (UUID) being revealed. |
| `voter` | `String` | yes | Committee-member identity (validator address, hex). Must match the earlier commit. |
| `verdict` | `bool` | yes | Revealed verdict: true = commitment did not verify (upholds), false = dismisses. |
| `salt` | `String` | yes | Reveal salt (hex) — must reproduce the earlier commit hash. |
| `signature` | `String` | yes | Hex Ed25519 signature by the seat's consensus key over the reveal, from tenzro_signChallengeVote on the voter's own node. |

**Calls.** `tenzro_revealChallengeVote` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "reveal_challenge_vote", "arguments": {"challenge_id": "0x…", "voter": "…", "verdict": false, "salt": "…", "signature": "…"}}}
```

Administrators only. Withdraw one access token by `jti`, or every live token of `did`. Give exactly one.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |

| `jti` | `Option<String>` | no | The token id to withdraw |
| `did` | `Option<String>` | no | Withdraw every live token of this DID |

### `revoke_delegated_agent`

Admit a signed RevokeIdentity transaction that revokes a delegated agent with its root's approval (passkey or machine hardware key) of a revoke_identity challenge. The node checks the approval against chain state and admits it; every validator re-verifies it, and once it is in a block every node refuses the agent and revokes its tokens.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `signed_transaction` | `PaySignedRevokeIdentity` | yes | A signed RevokeIdentity transaction, as tenzro_sendRawTransaction takes it (envelope, tx_type {"RevokeIdentity":{"op":{did, reason, approver_did, approval}}}, public_key, signature). Any account may sign it; the root's approval of the revoke_identity challenge inside op authorises the revocation |

**Calls.** `tenzro_revokeIdentity` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "revoke_delegated_agent", "arguments": {"signed_transaction": "…"}}}
```

### `revoke_jwt`

Revoke a JWT by its jti. Requires a signed did_envelope from the token's bearer DID or the controller DID that authorized it — a jti travels in every audit row, so knowing one is not authority to destroy it. Cascades to any tokens minted from the revoked token.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `jti` | `String` | yes | JWT id (jti) to revoke. Cascades to any tokens minted from it. |
| `did_envelope` | `String` | yes | Hex DID envelope proving control of the token's bearer DID or of the controller DID that authorized it, bound to method tenzro_revokeJwt with the jti as the params hash. A jti is an identifier, not a credential. |
| `reason` | `Option<String>` | no | Optional human-readable revocation reason. |

**Calls.** `tenzro_revokeJwt` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "revoke_jwt", "arguments": {"jti": "…", "did_envelope": "…"}}}
```

| `grant_id` | `String` | yes |  |
| `authorization` | `Option<CustodyAuthorizationWire>` | no | The owner's approval of a revoke challenge for this grant |


### `route_by_intent`

Discover the best model for an intent (use case + budget + quality floor + cost-quality knob) without naming a model. Returns the selected model_id, tier, estimated cost, fallback chain, the difficulty cluster the prompt landed in, that model's observed error rate in the cluster, and the winning provider's address and endpoint when the offer came from another operator. Discovery only — dispatches nothing and records no spend, though the per-DID budget gate and the wallet-balance ceiling still apply, so an unaffordable request is refused here. Use chat_by_intent to select and run in one call

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `use_case` | `String` | yes | Use case: 'chat', 'code', 'reasoning', 'research', 'summarize', 'extract', or 'embed'. Maps to a modality and biases quality tiering |
| `budget` | `Option<u128>` | no | Per-request cost cap in smallest TNZO unit. Accepts number or decimal string. Absent = no per-request cap. OptionalOption<String> |
| `optimize` | `Option<f64>` | no | Cost-quality knob in [0.0, 1.0]: 0.0 = cheapest acceptable, 1.0 = strongest. Optional |
| `quality_floor` | `Option<String>` | no | Reject any model below this tier: 'cheap' or 'strong'. Optional |
| `est_input_tokens` | `Option<u64>` | no | Estimated input tokens for cost estimation. Optional |
| `est_output_tokens` | `Option<u64>` | no | Estimated output tokens for cost estimation. Optional |
| `payer_did` | `Option<String>` | no | Payer DID. When set, the per-DID rolling-window budget gate is enforced. Optional |
| `payer_address` | `Option<String>` | no | Payer wallet address (hex). When set, the payer's on-chain TNZO balance is a hard ceiling: unaffordable models are dropped. Optional |
| `prompt` | `Option<String>` | no | The text the model would answer. Used only to place the request in a difficulty cluster so selection accounts for how hard the prompt is; it is not sent to any provider. Without it the decision rests on declared metadata alone. Optional |

**Calls.** `tenzro_routeIntent` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "route_by_intent", "arguments": {"use_case": "…"}}}
```

### `route_difficulty_stats`

Read the node's difficulty index: how many prompt clusters it has discovered and how many prompts landed in each. With model_id, also returns that model's per-cluster outcome counters and error rate. An operator diagnostic — routing does not depend on it. enabled=false means the node has no embedding model loaded and routes on declared metadata alone

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model_id` | `Option<String>` | no | Model to report per-cluster outcome counters and error rate for. Omit for the cluster map alone. Optional |

**Calls.** `tenzro_routeDifficultyStats` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "route_difficulty_stats", "arguments": {}}}
```

### `segment`

Run prompt-driven image segmentation. `prompts` is an array of `{type:'point', x, y, is_foreground}` (is_foreground true for a point inside the object, false for background) or `{type:'box', x0, y0, x1, y1}` objects, in original-image pixels. Returns mask data with IOU scores. The encoder caches the per-image embedding, so repeated prompts against the same image only re-run the decoder.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model_id` | `String` | yes | Registered segmenter id (e.g. 'sam2-base', 'sam2-large', 'edgesam', 'mobilesam') |
| `image_base64` | `String` | yes | Base64-encoded image bytes |
| `prompts` | `Vec<SegmentPromptParam>` | yes | Prompts: array of `{type:'point', x, y, is_foreground}` (is_foreground true marks a point inside the object, false marks background) or `{type:'box', x0, y0, x1, y1}` objects. Coordinates are original-image pixels. |
| `verification` | `Option<String>` | no | Verification level: none, receipt, optimistic or tee |
| `provider` | `Option<String>` | no | Serve on this provider's offer (payee address, hex). Without it, a model this node does not serve goes to a provider offering it |

**Calls.** `tenzro_segment` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**

```json
{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "segment", "arguments": {"model_id": "0x…", "image_base64": "…", "prompts": []}}}
```

### `set_provider_pricing`

Set one of this node's price cards: the default card, or the card for one model. A card prices registered units (or units at a tier) in billionths of a dollar or TNZO base units; the operator sets every price. Administrators only.

**Input.**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model_id` | `Option<String>` | no | Catalog id of the model the card is for. Omit to set the card every model without its own is priced on. |
| `card` | `ModelsRateCard` | yes | The price card: {denom: 'nano_usd' \| 'wei', lines: {<unit or unit@tier>: {price, per_exp}}, min_charge}. A price is per 10^per_exp units, in billionths of a dollar (settled in TNZO at the chain's rate) or in TNZO base units. Units are registered ids such as input_tokens, output_tokens, reasoning_tokens, cached_read_tokens, pixel_steps, characters, audio_out_ms, rerank_pairs, action_chunks. |

**Calls.** `tenzro_getProviderPricing`, `tenzro_setProviderPricing` (see [RPC.md](RPC.md)).

**Example.**
